// why: A tracked image a nested `.gitignore` matches, as a rule like `*.png` takes a baseline screenshot. nx walks past it, so it is in no task hash, and every gate that reads it answers an edit with its cached pass — measured on `docs/acr.md`, which a one-line `docs/.gitignore` took out of the hashes of `check-acr` and `check-docs` while both still read it. The file is binary, so a rule that walks only the readable files lets it through.
